as_told.title: Rick Strassman's DMT studies in room 531 of the University of New Mexico hospital
as_told.place_text: University of New Mexico hospital, Albuquerque, New Mexico

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says that in the early 1990s a researcher named Rick Strassman ran a large study of DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, with 60 volunteers, some of whom described experiences like alien abductions. In another part of the conversation Gallimore places the studies in room 531 of the University of New Mexico hospital. If true, it would tie the drug to the kinds of encounters abductees describe.
